errors.evidence: The described range for the y-axis is the range of the data, not the range of the axis itself. The y-axis ticks are labeled from 38 to 48.

The line starts near x=0, but the first labeled data point, 38.11, is clearly located at an x-coordinate between 0 and 5000, not at 0.
The data value at x-coordinate 10000 is 46.87, not 42.33. The value 42.33 corresponds to an x-coordinate of approximately 5000.

The description fails to mention the labeled data point at x=10000, which has a value of 46.87. It also doesn't mention the point at x≈5000 with value 42.33, instead misattributing that value to x=10000.
